best: The pack power path on Cells and Gauge and the four-switch input stage on USB read left to right as real power paths (fuse, CHG/DSG FETs, shunt with Kelvin RC; input shunt, cap bank, half bridges, inductor), with clear section titles and explanatory notes.
worst: USB sheet: BQ25756 support parts (bootstrap diodes/caps, gate resistors, FB divider) hang off long orthogonal runs on the right while the power stage they drive sits at the top joined only by HG/LG/SW labels, and the middle of the sheet is largely empty with the EEPROM floating alone.

Small text collisions: I2CC_SCL/I2CC_SDA/CHG_INT labels overlap the R403/R402/R404 values, the stacked GND pin numbers under U401 and U405 are illegible, and D103's value runs into the C108 ground symbol.
BQ40Z50 cell-filter wiring uses crossing staircase runs to VC1-VC4/PBI/PACK/TS pins, and the MCU antenna pi match is drawn as a loop around rather than a textbook pi.
